scaleBeatText: A sequence of foods on the table. Eat them in the right order.

⛓️ Stonebridge doesn't say no. They say: "They'll take Haven — but the tribute is 6,000 kcal/week, not 5,000. Take it or leave it." The table is set — accept their terms, sweeten the offer, or walk away.

With Haven grieving, Thornfield installs their own speaker at the table — but the bond is young, and they're still deciding what Haven is. The new speaker wants to talk before the tribute changes. Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.

Seven days of silence, and the silence answered for Haven. Thornfield's new speaker reads it plainly. (Trust -6.) Thornfield installs their own speaker at the table after all — tribute rises to 7,500 kcal/week. Grief became leverage, and they knew it would.

◈ THE TABLE IS SET. A ring of pale light waits — take your seat from Haven when you are ready. Nothing is final until you sit.

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (17/8/3), 7 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.

Or REFUSE the scale itself — stay a free fire at regional, whatever that costs. The System will not offer twice.

doorOffer.promptHtml: The ring of pale light. The too-many-angled faces. The trillions of eyes. The ring waits. Seven doors — some open, some priced beyond you. The choice is which risk you take. ◈ the Feared — 28 distinct monsters faced blow-by-blow. The footage exists, and it plays unasked. (standing: 100) ◇ the Indispensable — The Indispensable needs a full seat — the galaxy must actually need you, not just notice you. ◈ the Beloved — Viewership 42, fan favor 35 — the galaxy's favorite, by the numbers. (standing: 100) ◈ the Witness — 7 exposures on the record. The docket is real. (standing: 81) ◈ the Assimilated — Always open. The table takes anyone — that's what makes it a trap, and what makes it safe. (standing: 45) ◈ the Defiant — Defiance 4 on the record. The 'no' is earned. (standing: 36) ◈ the Relay —
